instruction: Can you enable the minimal view interface? I prefer a cleaner, more minimalist interface without all the controls visible.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC minimal view interface. Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric to validate the qt-minimal-view setting (1=enabled, 0=disabled) in vlcrc config file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the qt-minimal-view setting in VLC config file
Getter (get_vlc_config) successfully extracts the vlcrc configuration file from the correct OS-specific path
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly reads the config file and compares qt-minimal-view value against expected '1' (enabled)
Expected value '1' is semantically correct for enabling minimal view interface
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are applied before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires - enabling minimal view interface
